title: Generate a published MOVi-A dataset scene with Kubric and Blender
question: Can we regenerate MOVi-A synthetic videos and their ground-truth annotations?

paper.title: Kubric: A scalable dataset generator
paper.locator: Section 4.1 and Figure 5, MOVi-A scene-generation properties; Table 3 learning results require a separate training reproduction.

source.license: Kubric Apache-2.0 source; BlenderGPLruntime; KuBasicgeometry and generated scene/image derivatives CC BY-SA4.0.

inputs.description: Paper-date authorMOVi-A defaults; CLEVRobjects/background/camera; seed42; currentpublicKuBasicmanifest; original2022assetbytes notestablished.
inputs.access: Public authors code and public dataset bucket; retain asset manifest and terms.

changes_from_author: Use authors digest-pinned bpy module extracted unprivileged from image layers because Docker daemon unavailable.
Use paper-date code rather than currentmain, whose Blender4.3 shader changes conflict with historical2.93.
Modern TensorFlow for fileI/O; historicalTFDS/NumPy pins reconstructed.

target.observable: MOVi-A clip frame count, image dimensions and moving-object count
target.reference: Kubric Figure 5 and author MOVi-A README: 24-frame 256x256 clips, 3-10 objects
target.tolerance: Exact frame count/dimensions; generated object count within author parameter support; no per-pixel target or learning metric
target.tolerance_basis: Declared discrete schema/design invariants, not a claim of identical sampled images
target.scope: One seeded dataset-generator scene; no Table 3 model-training performance claim

execution.result: Paper-date author worker ran to completion onCPU:24frames,256×256,7objects and all rendered annotations/native states. Nine design checks passed; second scene has identical instance metadata and24/24RGBAhashes.

measurements.locator: Section4.1/Figure5 MOVi-A dataset design; not Table3 learning scores
limitations: A newly generated scene, not a pixel-exact reconstruction of a figure5illustration.
Public currentKuBasic assets; exact original2022asset bytes are not established.
ModernPyBullet/TensorFlow dependency versions differ from original rendering image package set.
No SAVi/SIMONe training or foregroundARI reproduction.

comparison.interpretation: PublishedMOVi-A dataset-design properties match; all9numerical/design checks passed. Originalfigurepixels, originalassetbytes andTable3learning scores are outside this comparison.
